answer: Each agent ID must answer a fresh compute puzzle tied to its own key every epoch, and the puzzle's difficulty doubles for every other ID that has shared an IP block or signing pattern with it in the jetty logs. One honest agent pays about a cent of GPU time. A farm running forty IDs from one reef of servers pays forty times as much, and each linked ID raises the price for the rest of the cluster. Old solutions can't be reused like a relic, because each puzzle seeds from the previous block hash.
